SELECT p.code, p.name, p.spec, p.storage,
(SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'STORAGE_METHOD' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = p.storage LIMIT 1) AS storage_nm,
p.client_code, (SELECT c.name FROM clients c WHERE c.client_code = p.client_code LIMIT 1) AS client_name, COALESCE(p.discontinued, 0) AS discontinued, p.discontinued_at, p.discontinued_by, p.discontinued_note, COALESCE(p.stock_qty, 0) AS stock_qty, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bom b WHERE b.product_code = p.code) AS material_count, (SELECT MAX(s.schedule_date) FROM production_schedule s WHERE s.product_code = p.code AND s.actual_qty IS NOT NULL AND s.actual_qty != '') AS last_produced_date FROM products p WHERE COALESCE(p.discontinued, 0) = 0 ORDER BY p.code DESC
